title: Utilization Share of Units Asked For in Prior Authorization Extensions
content:
When a Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization extension is recorded, the share of the units asked for follows the uses posted on the authorization with service dates in the two months before the day of the extension.

## Rule

| Uses posted on the authorization in the two months before the extension | Share of the units asked for |
|---|---|
| fewer than twice the class's weekly frequency cap | one third (1 of 3 thirds) |
| at least twice but fewer than four times the weekly frequency cap | two thirds (2 of 3 thirds) |
| four times the weekly frequency cap or more | the full units asked for (3 of 3 thirds) |

The share is taken first: the units asked for are multiplied by the share's thirds and divided by 3, and the result is rounded down to a whole unit; any deduction for the units remaining is then taken from that shared figure.

The uses counted are the units posted as used on this authorization whose service dates fall in the two months before the day of the extension. In a class whose weekly frequency cap is zero, no count is fewer than twice or four times the cap, so the full units asked for are taken.

## Worked cases (hypothetical class with a weekly frequency cap of 3 units; 10 units asked for)

Twice the cap is 6 and four times the cap is 12.

- 5 uses posted: fewer than 6, one third; ten multiplied by one and divided by three is three and one third, rounded down to 3 units.
- 6 uses posted: not fewer than 6 but fewer than 12, two thirds; ten multiplied by two and divided by three is six and two thirds, rounded down to 6 units.
- 11 uses posted: two thirds, 6 units.
- 12 uses posted: the full 10 units.
